questions.question: To which foreign god did King Ahaziah send messengers when he was injured?
What happened to the soldiers sent to seize Elijah?
options: They turned aside and very quickly lost his trail
They seized Elijah and bound him with cords
They fled in great terror back to the king
Fire came down and consumed two groups of fifty
questions.answer: Fire came down and consumed two groups of fifty

questions.question: Elijah prophesied that Ahaziah would not recover but would die.
Elijah said Ahaziah would die because he sought a foreign god instead of the _____ of Israel.
_____ came down from heaven and consumed the captains and their fifties.
